## Checklist
- [ ] `pytest` passes locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated for code changes
- [ ] Legal-mapping changes cite EUR-Lex or Commission guidance and have a second reviewer
- [ ] No real vulnerability details, credentials or identifiable SME data
- [ ] Synthetic data is labelled; new GitHub Actions are pinned to full SHAs
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated; version bumped in all metadata files if releasing (`python tools/check_release.py`)
